name: @broberg/web-clipper
description: The fleet's one web-clipper base (Trail Web Clipper, Jam Clipper). First piece: @broberg/web-clipper/core — the fingerprint engine: a fingerprint per unit (role + content + position), a chain fingerprint that includes the previous one, send-only-new, idempotent resend keys, and branches when an earlier unit changes (nothing is overwritten). No browser dependency.
